payload.summary: verify:phone-chrome and verify:ui cannot go green in a cloud sandbox: three failures are the unpinned Chromium, not the code
payload.detail: Established 2026-09-20 by running the three failures against a clean origin/main worktree (aef181f55) with the same environment, and reading the saved failure snapshots. They reproduce identically on main, so they are a property of the sandbox, not of any branch. ROOT CAUSE, found rather than guessed: the only installable browser here is /opt/pw-browsers/chromium = chromium-1194 = Chromium 141.0.7390.37, because cdn.playwright.dev is 403 under the egress policy and the revision Playwright 1.63.0 pins is 1243 / Chromium 153. (1) tests/ui-smoke.spec.ts "document frame stretches the canvas owner at phone and desktop" and "document viewer puts the PDF preview first with pinned evidence after it on mobile" both fail with getByTestId(pdf-canvas-scroll).locator(canvas) "element(s) not found". The error-context snapshot shows the viewer in its error state with the text "this[#re].getOrInsertComputed is not a function" and a Retry preview button. pdfjs-dist@6.3.289 calls Map.prototype.getOrInsertComputed, a V8 addition Chromium 141 does not have, so pdf.js throws during load and no canvas is ever created. The demo PDFs and cover images are all present; nothing is missing from the fixture. (2) tests/ui-pwa.spec.ts "has a browser-valid manifest, installable icons, and a root worker" fails with installability error "in-incognito" — Chromium refusing because every Playwright BrowserContext is off-the-record. Every other assertion in that test (manifest URL, manifest contents, all icon probes, service-worker scope/state/controller) passes first. CONSEQUENCE FOR AGENTS: three failures out of ~798 passing is the FLOOR for a chromium browser gate in this environment, on any branch. Do not read it as a branch signal, and do not "fix" a test to make it pass here. CI runs the pinned browser and the Production UI chromium shards are green on recent main (7936c3f9, cfb5ed90, and shard 3 on aef181f55). NOT ESTABLISHED: per-test CI granularity, because gh run view --log is Forbidden here (results-receiver.actions.githubusercontent.com); only job-level green was read. That Chromium 153 stops reporting in-incognito is an inference from CI being green, not a direct observation. TO UNBLOCK: either allowlist cdn.playwright.dev so the pinned revision installs, or teach the browser gate to recognise this known trio and report them as environment-floor rather than failures.
